approach.style: autonomous llm repair agent with dynamic prompting
phases: initialize dynamic prompt with role, goals, guidelines, and current state
let the model choose and invoke repair tools through middleware
update prompt with tool outputs and iterate cycles under a budget
apply candidate patches and validate against tests before final output
approach.implementation_mode: Python/SWE-bench port of the ICSE'25 paper's design with its MIT prompts adapted from Java; fault localization by SBFL over FORECAST's traces instead of perfect localization

evaluation_risk_mitigation.test_information_leakage: mitigated by emphasizing whole-suite validation and by reporting improvements beyond prior techniques, not only reproducing failing-test outcomes.
